title: Curated Sand3D pattern references for Nyfasi reconstruction
purpose: Shortlist produced from the metadata-only Sand3D catalogue. References inform modelling patterns only; no source geometry, program bodies or dimensions are copied into the Nyfasi reconstruction.
dataset_layer_license: CC-BY-4.0 as stated by Sandflow dataset cards; item-level source licences below remain applicable.
selection_method: Keyword match against roller, bearing, shaft, housing, wheel, gear and mechanical assembly terms; manually selected for relevance.
reuse_gate: Inspect the full source record and licence before any code or geometry adaptation.
Preserve attribution and modification notices for CC-BY assets.
AutoMate source records are CC0-1.0; Sandflow's generated dataset layer remains CC-BY-4.0.
Do not treat any exemplar as evidence of Nyfasi dimensions, geometry or manufacturing intent.
